{{Top}}
The '''Gehenbar hive''' was a [[Geonosian hive/Legends|Geonosian hive]] and the chief rival of the ruling [[Stalgasin hive/Legends|Stalgasin hive]]. They held their former leader [[Typtus the First]] in reverence.

[[Typtus of the 33rd Egg]] of Gehenbar once plotted to attack Stalgasin with his forces and destroy their spire with explosives.
